description: The committed nominal sweep point: every degradation axis at zero/undegraded, every swept system parameter at its IS §9.1 labeled default. 41000 lux is undegraded daylight, deliberately off the #47 sweep grid (the grid probes degradation; nominal is the absence of it). stiffness_k_n_mm = 10 is the D-026 log-grid midpoint — IS §9.1 lists no default for k (derived envelope; Phase 1 outputs the required-stiffness band) — arbitrary, labeled.
